summary: Feed-forward models accurately estimate camera motion and 3D geometry from short video windows. However, computational and memory costs prevent direct inference on sequences containing thousands of frames.
takeaways: However, computational and memory costs prevent direct inference on sequences containing thousands of frames.
Conversely, frame-level optimization offers local flexibility, but scaling it globally is computationally expensive and can break metric scale.
Experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of HiP3R in improving camera trajectories and 3D reconstruction.
